description: Schedule 8812 Credit Limit Worksheet B, TY2025 MFJ wages 70,000, 2 qualifying children, solar 10,000 (line 13 = 3,000; no EITC above $64,430). Tax on TI 38,500 (row 38,500-38,550, midpoint 38,525: 2,385 + 12% x 14,675 = 4,146). CTC after phase-out 4,400 (8812 line 12). Worksheet B: line 2 = 2 x 1,700 = 3,400; line 5 = 15% x (70,000 - 2,500) = 10,125; line 13 = min(3,400, 10,125) = 3,400; line 14 = 4,400 - 3,400 = 1,000. Form 5695 line 14 worksheet uses Worksheet B line 14 instead of Form 1040 line 19: 4,146 - 1,000 = 3,146 -> line 15 = min(3,000, 3,146) = 3,000. Worksheet B line 15 = 3,000 -> Worksheet A line 4: CTC limit = 4,146 - 3,000 = 1,146 -> nonrefundable CTC 1,146; ACTC = min(4,400 - 1,146 = 3,254, 3,400) = 3,254. Tax after credits 4,146 - 1,146 - 3,000 = 0; net = -3,254 (refund).
